mentions.note: won Leicester Mercury 20 miles in a world best 2:22:53
Mexican, Olympic champion; won Jubilee 20km in 88:03

photos.c: Mexicans filled the first five places in the Southern Jubilee 20km, the winner being Olympic Champion Daniel Bautista (115). Carl Lawton (6) was the first Briton home in sixth place.

photo.caption: Mexicans filled the first five places in the Southern Jubilee 20km, the winner being Olympic Champion Daniel Bautista (115). Carl Lawton (6) was the first Briton home in sixth place.
